SIDIS.selection: Caller must explicitly select the publication convention and source; no automatic depolarization or angle-sign inference
SIDIS.kinematics: Fixed point or reported means; finite P integration fixes all other kinematics, so the common sigma0 cancels. General x/z/Q2/y acceptance integration is not supplied.

angular.ratio_of_angular_means: SIAAngularFactor supplies a fixed source-labeled scalar <sin^2(theta)>/<1+cos^2(theta)>.
angular.mean_of_angular_ratio: SIAMeanOfRatio supplies a fixed source-labeled scalar <sin^2(theta)/(1+cos^2(theta))> and a nonblank declared averaging measure.
angular.policy: Preserve the declared source kind. No inference from a scalar value, reconstruction of component means or numerical angular distribution in the fit loop. The measure descriptor records caller provenance; it is not an experimental admission certificate.
angular.measure_relation: With factorized fixed other kinematics and event weights proportional to acceptance*(1+cos^2(theta)), a mean of the pointwise ratio under event weights equals a ratio of means under acceptance weights. Under the same arbitrary weights the two expressions generally differ.
angular.bin_limit: A scalar factor does not certify factorization of joint angle/momentum/energy/acceptance weights or equality across charge categories.

SIA.approximation: Paper's linearized double-ratio amplitude; do not substitute the Fourier coefficient of an exact nonlinear ratio

momentum_integration: Finite supplied [Pmin,Pmax], positive fixed Gauss nodes/weights with the P*dP Jacobian. Project the P quadrature onto fixed J0/J1/J2 radial weights once. Integrate each numerator and denominator before division or charge-category ratios. Uniform P acceptance is an explicit reconstruction assumption, not an experimental acceptance correction.
evaluation: Reuse prepared initial/evolution responses once per parameter evaluation for all SIA charge pairs. All fitted arithmetic and derivatives remain Julia. No provider/native/Python/model calls in the numerical loop. Settings and angular factors are fixed.
denominators: Require finite positive final UU denominators; retain signed integrands and numerators. No absolute-value or positivity clamp, and no arbitrary bound on the fitted asymmetry is inserted.

validation_policy.refinement_policy: Retain coarse levels. At or above order32 accept only an adjacent-order momentum difference at or below momentum_refinement_max_scaled=1e-7, declared before formal runs. Joint radial/evolution refinement and independent physical references retain physical_value_max_scaled=1e-4. Budget exhaustion is FAIL. Source/parameter/grid limits remain those of the parent contracts.

limitations: No experimental admission, historical fit or real-data extraction
Publication angle signs, depolarization removal, acceptance, bin definitions, covariance and overlap require separate reviewed adapters
No thrust-frame, eta, unidentified-hadron or STAR observable
No general multidimensional acceptance integration or production performance/coverage certificate
Parent missing-code, source-extrapolation, Collins-approximation and production cache limitations remain
Explicit source-kind/measure metadata does not approve a publication adapter, joint acceptance factorization, covariance or event overlap.

angular_source_references.location: Tables IV/V: mean of the pointwise angular ratio
Belle2012 erratum replaces asymmetry Tables IV/V; preserve corrected-input provenance and avoid a second correction
angular_source_references.scope: version provenance; full primary table matching is a separate data gate

angular_source_references.location: Double-ratio angular integration discussion and Tables I/II/III
angular_source_references.scope: source notation; no general acceptance claim

synthetic_angular_fixture.averaging_measure: synthetic fixed event weights [0.6,0.4] at cos_squared(theta) [0,1]; fixed other kinematics
synthetic_angular_fixture.reference_policy: Independent BigFloat weighted averages; equal effective factors share the independent scalar/adaptive finite-difference arrays. Both typed prediction paths are checked separately.
